title: STAR: Semantic-Criticality Tiered Allocation of Radio Resources via Zero-Shot Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.13238v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In remote inference, edge devices transmit high-resolution images over wireless links to a receiver, where an artificial intelligence (AI) model answers task-specific questions about these images to enable reliable decisions. These answers are often determined by a small set of task-causal pixels, such as those of text, whose corruption changes the answer, so these pixels must be delivered with high fidelity. Conventional transmission protects every pixel equally, so it either consumes many resource elements (REs) or corrupts these regions at low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). translated_title: STAR：基于零样本学习的语义关键性分层无线电资源分配
translated_abstract: 在远程推理中，边缘设备通过无线链路将高分辨率图像传输至接收端，由人工智能（AI）模型回答关于这些图像的任务特定问题，以实现可靠决策。这些答案往往由一小部分任务因果像素（如文本像素）决定，这些像素一旦损坏就会改变答案，因此必须以高保真度进行传输。传统传输方式对所有像素一视同仁地加以保护，因而要么消耗大量资源元素（RE），要么在低信噪比（SNR）下损坏这些关键区域。为克服这些局限，本文提出了一种零样本、领域无关的框架，称为语义关键性分层资源分配（STAR）。具体而言，通过冻结的视觉-语言模型的注意力导出逐像素的语义关键性指示器（SCI），因此只需更改提示词即可处理新任务和新领域，无需……
tldr: 提出了STAR框架，利用冻结视觉-语言模型的注意力导出逐像素语义关键性指示器，对决定任务答案的关键像素进行分层高保真无线电资源分配，且仅需更改提示词即可零样本适配新任务与领域。
en_tdlr: STAR is a zero-shot, domain-agnostic framework that derives a per-pixel semantic-criticality indicator from a frozen vision-language model's attention to tier-allocate radio resources with high fidelity for task-causal pixels, adapting to new tasks and domains by simply changing the prompt.
